description: Bounded source-shaped in-place matrix/scalar recurrence from TSVC s257.

pinned_source.attribution: The TSVC source comments attribute its non-four-digit codelets to David Callahan, Jack Dongarra, and David Levine, Test Suite for Vectorizing Compilers.
pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license grant was found in the pinned TSVC source or repository material reviewed. Ports are independent implementations of the bounded loop behavior; no upstream source code or comments are reused and no upstream license or endorsement is claimed.

contract.operation: For each pass, visit i from 1 to n-1 and then j from 0 to n-1; set A[i]=AA[j,i]-A[i-1], then AA[j,i]=A[i]+BB[j,i]. Return the sum of final A and AA.
contract.input_layout: [n, passes, A[0..n), AA row-major n*n, BB row-major n*n]
contract.arithmetic_type: The source uses binary64 double. Under these bounds the integer-valued additions and subtractions stay below 2^53 and are exact; the ports use signed i64 arithmetic.
contract.traversal: Passes ascend; within each pass, i ascends and j ascends. Each AA write and each A[i] assignment is visible to subsequent source operations.
contract.output: Sum of all final A entries and all final AA entries; BB is unchanged and is not included.
contract.success_result: The final checksum as signed i64.

input.encoding: n, passes, A, AA row-major, then BB row-major
